attributes.title: Updates in General Internal Medicine for Specialists 2027
attributes.series: Updates in General Internal Medicine for Specialists (Harvard Medical School)
attributes.credits_text: 56 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 38 AAFP · 56 AAPA Cat 1
attributes.summary:
Updates in General Internal Medicine for Specialists runs Monday to Friday, January 25 to 29, 2027, at the Fairmont Copley Plaza in Boston, with a live online option and recordings available for 11 months. The audience includes medical sub-specialists, surgeons, psychiatrists, OB/GYN clinicians, NPs, PAs and nurses who want a broad internal medicine update.

The course carries 56 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 56 AAPA Category 1 CME credits, including 14 Massachusetts risk management credits. Early fees, valid until January 2, 2027, are $1,395 for physicians and $1,195 for NPs and PAs; the hotel block is available until December 30, 2026.
